recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, low-contrast portrait of a woman with curly brown hair, wearing a white knit V-neck sweater, reclining against a dark, textured sofa. The lighting is highly diffused, creating a hazy, ethereal glow typical of late 90s and early 2000s photography.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright white of the sweater against the dark, muted background creates a central vertical anchor.
The soft texture of the knitwear mimics the diffused, grainy quality of the overall image.
The subject's raised arms frame the face, creating a triangular composition at the top of the frame.
coreInvariants: Muted, slightly desaturated color palette with cool blue undertones in shadows
Visible film grain or digital noise mimicking 35mm film

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, captured from the waist up, filling approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face, specifically her eyes and lips, serves as the focal point despite the soft focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the curve of the arms downward to the face, then follows the line of the V-neck sweater through the torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark sofa provides significant negative space on the left and right, emphasizing the brightness of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and pale lavender (sweater and skin highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and muted brown (sofa and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-key highlights and crushed, slightly lifted shadows.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with curly dark hair reclining on a dark textured couch, wearing a white knit sweater. Use a soft-focus lens effect with high bloom on the highlights. The lighting should be cool-toned and diffused, creating a hazy 90s aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out sans-serif font in a semi-transparent white to maintain the ethereal, airy quality of the image.

verificationChecks: Is there a visible bloom effect on the white sweater?
Is the lighting diffused without harsh shadows?
Does the image have a nostalgic, film-like grain?

mustRedesign: Avoid any modern digital sharpness or high-dynamic-range (HDR) clarity
Ensure the skin tones are integrated into the soft-focus glow rather than standing out sharply

mustAchieve: Soft, tactile texture in the clothing

postGenerationChecks: Check for haloing around the subject's head due to the bloom effect.
Ensure the texture of the knitwear is visible but softened.
Verify the color balance leans toward cool pastels in the highlights.
Confirm the composition uses the arms as a framing device.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key subject in soft-textured clothing with a low-key, dark background, then apply a heavy diffusion filter and cool-toned color grading to simulate 90s-era celebrity portraiture.
